description: Jest 30.5.2's own text for a test that fails with a node:assert AssertionError (jest-circus `formatNodeAssertErrors`): equal, notEqual, strictEqual, deepStrictEqual, deepEqual, ok, throws, doesNotThrow, match, rejects and fail, a custom message, an assert inside a describe and in a hook, and an error that only carries code ERR_ASSERTION. Kept: every stderr line that is not a stack frame, a test list line (those carry durations), a time, a count line or runner noise. The results file's failureMessages are captured with each run of frames as <frames>. A black-box run, read by `provino`'s `jest-node-assert.test.ts`.

run.keepLines: ^(?!\s+at )(?!ERROR: failed)(?!\(node:)(?!\(Use )(?!\s+✕)(?!\s+(?:inside a describe|nested)$)(?!\s+>?\s*\d+ \|)(?!\s+\| +\^)(?!Time:)(?!Ran all)(?!Test Suites:)(?!Tests:)(?!Snapshots:)(?!Test results)(?!\s*$)
